04 Readability, by design

Ratios calculated from these exact hex values

Use near-neutral layers to organize the page, a limited set of accents for attention, and explicit labels for every status. The UI follows those color principles from Adobe Spectrum; it does not copy a stock Spectrum palette.

Normal text is checked against the WCAG 4.5:1 text-contrast threshold. Labels accompany color, and solid/dashed lines distinguish chart series. The numbers above are specific token-pair checks, not a claim that the whole dashboard has passed an accessibility audit.

05 Use the theme

Standalone HTML · reusable CSS

Nordic Night, ready to use

The full CSS contains Butter Paper, Southwest Night and Nordic Night. This theme-only update keeps the Nordic greys and both photo galleries intact. The iGage dashboard has not been modified. The HTML embeds its CSS and photographs and opens on its own.
